faq.item.1.a: Hold is a brokerage specialized in strategic wealth advisory. We operate across consortium, insurance, health and investments, structuring personalized solutions tailored to each client's profile and goals.
faq.item.2.a: We work with four integrated fronts: Consortium (interest-free wealth planning), Insurance (individual and corporate protection), Health (personalized plans for individuals and companies), and Investments (long-term wealth growth and management).
faq.item.3.a: We start with a diagnosis to understand your moment and goals. From there, we design the best strategy, present available options, and support you at every stage of the journey.
faq.item.4.q: What is a consortium and how does it work?
faq.item.4.a: A consortium is a collective purchase scheme regulated by Law 11,795/2008 and supervised by the Central Bank of Brazil. Participants pay monthly installments that form a common fund. Monthly assemblies take place where participants are awarded by lottery or bid.
faq.item.5.a: No. Costs involve only an administration fee, a reserve fund (when applicable), and insurance (if contracted). This makes it significantly more economical than conventional financing.
faq.item.6.q: Consortium vs financing: what's the difference?
faq.item.6.a: Consortium: no interest, medium-to-long-term planning, awarded by lottery or bid. Financing: immediate credit access, but with interest rates that make the total cost much higher.
faq.item.7.q: How can I be awarded in a consortium?
faq.item.7.a: By monthly lottery or by bid. Modalities include free bid, fixed bid, loyalty bid, and embedded bid. Hold advises the best contemplation strategy according to your profile and goal.
faq.item.8.q: Can I use FGTS (employment fund) in consortium?
faq.item.8.a: Yes, in real estate consortiums you can use FGTS to make bids, reduce the outstanding balance, or supplement the property value, as per the group's rules.
faq.item.9.a: Yes. We serve individuals and companies with asset protection solutions, life insurance, business insurance, and other products tailored to each client's or business's reality.
faq.item.10.q: Can I get a health plan through Hold?
faq.item.10.a: Yes. We work with individual, family, and corporate health plans, with personalized curation based on each client's profile, location, and needs.
faq.item.11.q: How does the partnership work for investment firms?
faq.item.11.a: Hold offers a structured consortium desk for partner firms. Your team can incorporate the solution into the portfolio without building its own operation, with continuous technical and commercial support from Hold.
faq.item.12.a: Yes. We operate with administrators authorized by the Central Bank of Brazil and properly registered insurers, ensuring security, transparency, and compliance in all operations.
